name: Technichem Organics Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1996, Technichem Organics is engaged in the business of manufacturing a wide range of chemicals, specialty chemicals, Pigment & Dye Intermediates, and Air Oxidation Chemistry.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
Company manufactures chemicals, including Pyrazoles, Pyrazolones, Specialty Chemicals, Pigment & Dye Intermediates, and Air Oxidation Chemistry. These serve industries like pharmaceuticals, agriculture, coatings, pigments, and dyes.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 58.1 to 78.4 days.
Working capital days have increased from 12.8 days to 78.7 days
